battle.name: 愛爾蘭獨立戰爭
battle.theater: 都柏林與愛爾蘭南部鄉野
battle.brief: 1919年1月21日，愛爾蘭共和軍在科克郡索羅黑德貝格伏擊皇家愛爾蘭警察巡邏，獨立戰爭由此開打，至1921年12月停火收場。卡面的1840年法式雷管步槍代表步槍點火技術的一次世代更替：雷管讓底火在濕霧裡也打得響，共和軍手上那批步槍正是這條譜系的末端產物。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 1919年至1921年的愛爾蘭獨立戰爭，交戰的兩方是英國的駐愛軍與愛爾蘭民族主義武裝。英方一側由四支武裝構成：駐愛爾蘭的英軍正規部隊（以第十愛爾蘭師、第六師第三十七與第三十八步兵旅等為主）、總部設在都柏林的皇家愛爾蘭警察隊（RIC）、1920年由英格蘭臨時招募的黑棕衣輔助警察大隊（Black and Tans），以及同年成立、1921年改編為北愛民防團的志願兵輔助分隊；英國海軍在科克與貝爾法斯特水域巡邏，皇家空軍以數個中隊提供夜間襲擊與砲兵觀測的支援。愛爾蘭一方是愛爾蘭共和軍（IRA）：1919年1月依郡劃分為四個省區旅，每旅再分為巡邏小隊與主動服務小隊，由愛爾蘭共和國軍諮詢會議與全國組織統一調度，武器主要由海外購買與從英軍庫房繳獲而來。政治與外交方面由新芬費黨主導，1919年1月21日在都柏林成立第一屆國會並宣告共和國，1920年1月組成臨時國會；地方上另有各郡的市政警與愛爾蘭志願軍殘餘。戰線覆蓋整個愛爾蘭島，主要戰鬥集中在都柏林、科克郡、克萊爾郡、基爾代爾郡、利默里克郡與蒂珀雷里郡的鄉間道路與莊園。
countriesEn: The Irish War of Independence of 1919 to 1921 was fought between the British forces stationed in Ireland and Irish nationalist armed groups. The British side had four components: regular British Army units in Ireland (chiefly the 10th (Irish) Division, together with the 37th and 38th Infantry Brigades of the 6th Division); the Royal Irish Constabulary (RIC), headquartered in Dublin; the Black and Tans, the temporary auxiliary police corps recruited in England in 1920; and the volunteer auxiliary companies raised in the same year and reorganised in 1921 as the Ulster Special Constabulary. The Royal Navy patrolled the waters off Cork and Belfast, and the Royal Air Force supplied several squadrons for night raids and artillery observation. The Irish side was the Irish Republican Army (IRA): from January 1919 it was organised by county into four provincial brigades, each subdivided into flying columns and Active Service Units, coordinated by the general organisation of the IRA and the Supreme Council of the Irish Republic. Its weapons came mostly from purchases abroad and from arms taken out of British depots. On the political side the Sinn Féin party took the lead: on 21 January 1919 the First Dáil Éireann was assembled in Dublin and proclaimed a republic, and in January 1920 a Second Dáil was convened; at local level there were the county civic guards and the remnants of the Irish Volunteers. The theatre of operations covered the whole island, and most of the fighting took place on the country roads and estates of Dublin, Cork, Clare, Kilkenny, Limerick and Tipperary.
people: 關鍵人物分屬三個群體。愛爾蘭方面：新芬費黨領袖阿瑟·格里菲斯是1919年至1921年對英交涉的首席談判者，1919年當選議員，1921年出任臨時國會主席，條約簽訂後擔任自治邦首任總理；埃德蒙·德·瓦萊拉於1919年1月當選議員，1920年11月在萊因斯特補選再度當選，1921年當選共和國總統，他堅持在《英愛條約》之外尋求更能維持主權的方案；麥可·柯林斯是共和軍情報主任（Director of Military Intelligence），策劃了都柏林四法院佔領行動與1920年的貝爾法斯特軍火走私，最後代表共和軍簽訂條約；理查德·穆爾卡希任共和軍參謀總長，1921年4月在威克洛郡的「徽章行動」中一度被英軍俘獲，其後脫逃並在內戰中組織國民軍；丹·布林與湯姆·馬洪等人在1919年1月21日於科克郡索羅黑德貝格執行了共和軍的第一次伏擊；哈里·博蘭在1921年9月於都柏林獄中身亡，其時正攜帶條約草案往來於都柏林與其他代表團之間；帕特里克·麥加里是共和軍派在都柏林的情報員，四法院行動的情報即由他提供。英方方面：陸軍元帥約翰·弗蘭奇於1919年任駐愛爾蘭英軍總司令，1920年4月由內維爾·麥克雷迪接任，後者推行以集中兵力、封鎖與突擊為主的清剿政策；英國首相勞合·喬治於1920年4月上任後推動停火談判；皇家愛爾蘭警察隊總監休·都德在都柏林主持警察系統改組，並推動黑棕衣與志願兵輔助分隊的組建；埃因·奧杜菲自1920年3月起以警察總監身分主持愛爾蘭方面的警察運作。
peopleEn: The key figures fall into three groups. On the Irish side: Arthur Griffith, leader of the Sinn Féin party, was the chief negotiator with Britain from 1919 to 1921; he was returned to parliament in 1919, presided over the Dáil Éireann in 1921, and became the first prime minister of the Free State after the treaty was signed. Éamon de Valera was elected in January 1919, was returned again in the Leinster by-election of November 1920, and was elected president of the republic in 1921; he insisted on seeking a settlement that would preserve more sovereignty than the Anglo-Irish Treaty allowed. Michael Collins was the IRA's Director of Military Intelligence; he planned the occupation of the Four Courts in Dublin and the gun-running of 1920, and finally signed the treaty on behalf of the republican army. Richard Mulcahy was the IRA's chief of staff; captured by the British in County Wexford during Operation Badge in April 1921, he escaped and later organised the National Army in the civil war. Dan Breen and Tom Mahony were among the men who carried out the IRA's first ambush, at Soloheadbeg in County Cork on 21 January 1919. Harry Boland died in Dublin prison in September 1921, at the very moment when he was carrying drafts of the treaty between Dublin and the other delegations. Patrick McGarry was the IRA's intelligence agent in Dublin, and it was he who supplied the intelligence on which the Four Courts operation was based. On the British side: Field Marshal Sir John French was commander-in-chief in Ireland in 1919, and was succeeded in April 1920 by Sir Nevil Macready, who pursued a policy of concentration, cordons and raids; British prime minister David Lloyd George took office in April 1920 and drove the truce negotiations. Hugh Tudor, as Director of the Royal Irish Constabulary, reorganised the police system from Dublin and pushed for the creation of the Black and Tans and the auxiliary companies. Eoin O'Duffy, as General Commissioner of the police, ran policing on the Irish side of the border from March 1920.
kits: 卡面是1840年法式雷管步槍：槍機以雷管取代火燧，底火不再靠擊打火石產生火花。雷管在1840年代進入法軍與歐洲各國的軍械庫，意味著步槍在雨、霧、泥濘中仍能可靠擊發，射程與射速同時提高。卡面這件兵器在1919年的位置，是同一條技術譜系的源頭，而不是戰場上的實配。共和軍與英軍在1919年至1921年實際使用的步槍主要有三類：一是英軍制式.303短步槍SMLE Mk III，栓動、彈匣十發；二是從英軍剩餘庫房與英國商人手中流入的栓式李-梅特福德步槍與李-恩菲爾德長槍，以及.577/450馬提尼—亨利步槍，這些槍與卡面同屬雷管擊發系統，槍機裡仍是底火，只不過已換成後膛式與手動槓桿；三是共和軍自德國及歐洲軍火商購得的德國毛瑟98式步槍，其血緣上延續法軍1840年制式步槍一路演成的栓動式樣。火器方面，英方配備維克斯機槍、路易士輕機槍與航空兵用機槍，並以裝甲車（第十七裝甲車營）、少量坦克、護甲列車與皇家空軍的DH.9夜間轟炸機投入鄉間；共和軍則以維克斯機槍、柯爾特自動手槍、Webley左輪手槍、少量湯普森衝鋒槍、手榴彈與地雷作戰，通信靠自行車與摩托車信使，後來用上簡單的炸藥破壞鐵路與橋樑。
kitsEn: The card shows a 1840 French percussion rifle: the lock uses a percussion cap in place of the flint, so that the priming no longer has to be produced by a spark from a struck stone. Percussion entered French and European arsenals in the 1840s, which meant that a rifle would still fire reliably in rain, fog and mud, with range and rate of fire improving together. The position of this weapon in 1919 is as the source of a single technical lineage rather than as a service issue in the field. The rifles actually used by the republican and British forces in 1919 to 1921 fall into three main groups. First, the British service .303 Short Magazine Lee-Enfield Mk III, a bolt-action rifle with a ten-round magazine. Second, bolt-action Lee-Metford rifles, Long Lee-Enfields and .577/450 Martini-Henrys that flowed into Irish hands from British surplus depots and from dealers in Britain; these belong to the same percussion system as the card, for the lock still carries a priming cap, though the action has by then become a breech-loading one worked by a lever. Third, German Mauser Model 98 rifles bought by the republicans from German and continental arms dealers, which stand in direct descent from the bolt-action pattern that grew out of the French service rifle of 1840. In support weapons the British side used Vickers machine guns, Lewis guns and aircraft machine guns, and committed armoured cars of the 17th Armoured Car Battalion, a small number of tanks, armoured trains and DH.9 night bombers of the Royal Air Force to the countryside. The republican side fought with Vickers machine guns, Colt automatic pistols, Webley revolvers, a few Thompson submachine guns, hand grenades and mines; messages were carried by bicycle and motorcycle couriers, and simple explosives were later used to cut railways and bridges.
tactics: 雙方的戰術幾乎是兩套相反的邏輯。共和軍走的是分散游擊：郡旅轄下的小分隊通常由二三十人組成，配一兩挺輕機槍與若干手榴彈，分成步槍手、機槍組與爆破組，晝間分散、黃昏集中；所謂飛縱隊在各郡之間長距離轉移，一次伏擊往往在行軍途中選定路口、山隘或橋頭，命中後即散開、人槍分離，幾分鐘內撤離現場，完事後回到本郡的安全屋與鄉村聚落。破壞鐵路、橋樑與電報線是常態手段，用以削弱英方的調動與通信；都市方面，四法院佔領把共和國的司法象徵同時當作總部使用。英方的回應是大範圍搜索加上密集駐軍：以步兵營封鎖村鎮、逐戶搜查、以機車巡邏封路、以裝甲車與護甲列車快速馳援、夜間由空軍轟炸，並封鎖武器來源。1920年11月21日都柏林球場上那一次行動演變成雙方交火，英方事後把裝甲車與武裝警察驅入場內的做法改為只在球場外圍架設封鎖線。英方同時把監禁當作戰術手段，1920年起以英國議會通過的《國會法案》大量羈押共和軍人員，並在1921年以絕食為槓桿，試圖瓦解共和軍的指揮骨幹。共和軍的答案是分散基層、統一指揮：郡旅與省區指揮部之間靠信使與定時的情報報告維持，省區以上由全國組織統籌，武器則在停火前夜以商船偷運上岸。
tacticsEn: The two sides fought on almost opposite logics. The republicans worked by dispersed guerrilla action: the sub-units of a county brigade commonly numbered twenty to thirty men, with one or two light machine guns and a few grenades, divided into riflemen, gun groups and demolition teams, dispersed by day and concentrated at dusk. The flying columns moved long distances from county to county; an ambush was usually chosen on the march, at a crossroads, a mountain pass or a bridge head, and once the blow had been struck the men scattered and separated from their weapons, leaving the scene within minutes and making their way back to safe houses and villages in their own county. Cutting railways, bridges and telegraph lines was a constant practice, intended to cripple British movement and communication; in the cities, the occupation of the Four Courts turned the symbol of Irish justice into a headquarters at the same time. The British answer was a large-scale search combined with a heavy permanent concentration of troops: infantry battalions sealed off towns and villages and searched house by house, motorcycle columns closed the roads, armoured cars and armoured trains rushed to the relief, aircraft bombed at night, and the sources of weapons were blockaded. On 21 November 1920 an operation at a football ground in Dublin turned into an exchange of fire, after which the British dropped the practice of driving armoured cars and armed police onto the ground itself and ringed the pitch from outside instead. The British also used imprisonment as a tactic, holding large numbers of republican prisoners under the Dáil Éireann Act from 1920 and using the hunger strike as a lever from 1921 in the hope of breaking the IRA's command structure. The republican answer was to decentralise the base and centralise command: county brigades and provincial headquarters were linked by couriers and scheduled intelligence reports, the provincial level reported upward to a general organisation, and arms were landed from merchant ships on the eve of the truce.
data: 可以核對的數字集中在幾處。時間：1919年1月21日開打，1921年12月6日簽訂《英愛條約》，12月11日中午1時起停火生效，全程約兩年十個月。兵力：英方駐愛爾蘭的英軍兵力高峰在四萬上下，另有皇家愛爾蘭警察隊約一萬二千人、黑棕衣大隊最多時約六千人、志願兵輔助分隊約兩千人；共和軍方面沒有可靠總表，但其步槍存量在1921年被估計已達一萬至兩萬支，其中德國毛瑟98式佔多數，火力以數百挺維克斯機槍為主。傷亡：兩側武裝人員的死亡總數超過一千人，受傷者逾四千五百人，愛爾蘭方面常引用約四百五十名共和軍成員陣亡的估計。羈押：1921年春愛爾蘭監獄關押的共和軍人員超過一萬二千人，4月21日起先後有八千至一萬人參與絕食，至5月底絕食結束，官方公布絕食期間共有七十餘名囚犯死亡，其中因絕食而死者包括曾當選議員的湯瑪士·艾什。軍火：1919年共和軍在英國購得約二百五十支.577/450馬提尼—亨利步槍，1920年8月一批運入都柏林的軍火在卡里克弗格斯關卡被扣，數量約為六百支李-恩菲爾德步槍與近九百支勃朗寧手槍；1921年4月另有一批規模更大的軍火在威克洛關卡被扣，內有湯普森衝鋒槍。距離：都柏林至科克約二百二十公里，1921年5月英方在克萊爾郡與威克洛郡的突擊行動都以縱深數十公里的臨時搜索為主，共和軍每次轉移多在夜間完成，日行數十公里。事件：1920年3月駐紮庫拉的英軍部隊中約三百五十名軍官拒絕進攻愛爾蘭，數十人遞辭呈。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked cluster in a few places. Time: the war opened on 21 January 1919; the Anglo-Irish Treaty was signed on 6 December 1921; the truce took effect at 1 p.m. on 11 December, a span of roughly two years and eleven months. Strength: British troops in Ireland peaked at around forty thousand, with roughly twelve thousand Royal Irish Constabulary, up to about six thousand Black and Tans, and some two thousand auxiliary volunteers; there is no reliable table for the IRA, but its stock of rifles is estimated to have reached between ten thousand and twenty thousand by 1921, mostly German Mauser 98s, with its firepower built on some hundreds of Vickers machine guns. Casualties: more than a thousand members of the armed forces on both sides were killed and over four thousand five hundred were wounded, and Irish accounts commonly cite an estimate of around four hundred and fifty republicans killed. Custody: by the spring of 1921 more than twelve thousand republican prisoners were held in Irish prisons, and from 21 April between eight thousand and ten thousand of them went on hunger strike; when the strike ended in late May the official count gave more than seventy prisoners dead during it, among them Thomas Ashe, an elected member of parliament, who had died of the strike itself. Arms: in 1919 the republicans bought about two hundred and fifty .577/450 Martini-Henry rifles in England; in August 1920 a consignment destined for Dublin was seized at the Carrickfergus customs house, comprising about six hundred Lee-Enfield rifles and close to nine hundred Browning pistols; a larger consignment was seized at the Wicklow customs house in April 1921, and it included Thompson submachine guns. Distances: Dublin to Cork is about two hundred and twenty kilometres, and the British raids in Clare and Wexford in May 1921 worked on a depth of tens of kilometres of country; the republicans made most of their transfers at night, covering a few tens of kilometres a day. Events: in March 1920 around three hundred and fifty British officers of the force at the Curragh refused to operate against Ireland, and several dozen tendered their resignations.
cause: 打起來有四層原因。最外層是愛爾蘭的憲政死結：自1801年英愛合併法把愛爾蘭併入聯合王國之後，愛爾蘭問題始終是英國議會裡最難處理的一條。戰前英國政府三次提出地方自治方案，1918年第三次《地方自治法案》送到議會時，第一次世界大戰正打到第三年，法案被擱置；1918年12月大選中，新芬費黨在愛爾蘭取得七十三席，幾乎壟斷了愛爾蘭的全部議席，選民等於用選票否決了英國的立法。1919年1月21日，第一屆國會在都柏林宣告獨立共和國；同日共和軍在科克郡索羅黑德貝格伏擊警察巡邏，武裝鬥爭由政治聲明轉為軍事行動。第二層是英方的應對把中間地帶壓縮：1919年英國議會通過《國會法案》，在都柏林設立處理叛亂的普通法院；新芬費黨的辦公處被查封，針對共和軍成員的禁令於1920年1月頒布，官方報紙被查。英方又把1920年北愛議會選舉中天主教少數派遭恐嚇的說法放大，愛爾蘭本土也出現愛爾蘭裔美國民族主義者煽動的德國陰謀恐慌，導致共和派辦公處被縱火，共和軍隨之以更強的力度回擊。第三層是鄉間的武裝化：一戰後退伍的愛爾蘭義軍回到鄉里，武器被分散藏匿在莊園與農舍，共和軍正是在這批既存武器與人脈上建起郡旅體系。第四層是英愛兩方面的經濟與社會對立：土地制度、自治法與天主教在北愛的處境，使停戰條件無論怎樣切都無法一次談成。
causeEn: There were four layers of cause. The outermost was the constitutional deadlock in Ireland: since the Act of Union of 1801 drew Ireland into the United Kingdom, the Irish question had always been the hardest item on the British parliamentary agenda. The British government put forward three schemes of home rule before the war, and when the third Home Rule Bill went to Parliament in 1918 the First World War had already run into its third year and the bill was left to lapse. In the general election of December 1918 Sinn Féin took seventy-three of the Irish seats, very nearly every seat there was, and the voters had by ballot rejected the British legislation. On 21 January 1919 the First Dáil Éireann assembled in Dublin and proclaimed an Irish republic; on the same day the IRA ambushed a police patrol at Soloheadbeg in County Cork, and the armed struggle moved from a political declaration to military action. The second layer was the British response, which closed the middle ground: the British parliament passed the Dáil Éireann Act in 1919, creating in Dublin a civil court to deal with rebellion; the offices of Sinn Féin were searched out, a ban on members of the IRA was imposed in January 1920, and the newspapers were suppressed. The British also inflated the scare over the treatment of the Catholic minority at the 1920 Ulster election, while in Ireland itself there was a German plot panic whipped up by Irish-American nationalists, which led to the burning of republican offices and the IRA's heavier answer. The third layer was the arming of the countryside: after the war the demobilised Irish Volunteers came home with their weapons hidden on farms and in houses, and the IRA built its county-brigade structure on top of that existing stock of men and metal. The fourth layer was the social and economic opposition in the two countries: land tenure, the home rule bill and the position of Catholics in the north made a negotiated settlement impossible to reach in one step, whichever way it was cut.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果，超出了英愛兩地的邊界。第一，它把愛爾蘭問題從自治推到了主權：自治派提出的方案被戰爭本身否定，新芬費黨在1921年分裂成議會派與軍事派，議會派接受《英愛條約》，並在1922年12月建立愛爾蘭自治邦，軍方則拒絕，並在1923年再分裂成不接受議席的正統派與堅持鬥爭的臨時派，這條裂痕此後一直在愛爾蘭政治中發作。第二，它在英國國內政治造成震盪：愛爾蘭的戰事、庫拉兵變與停火談判把原本由保守黨主導的政府拉下臺，1923年工黨首次掌權，議會的公開辯論把英格蘭與蘇格蘭的分權問題重新推上前檯。第三，它為後來的武裝鬥爭立下一套教科書：飛縱隊、連鎖情報、鄉村安全屋、分散的指揮結構，外加海外軍火來源與都市游擊，四十年後的北愛局勢幾乎照抄這些做法。第四，在國際上，1921年愛爾蘭的案子被送交國際聯盟審議，英國面對外部評論的壓力，雖然最終拒絕承認工黨政府的部分主張，但停火本身已是壓力之下的讓步。第五，這場戰爭也把北愛的問題凍結：多數派與少數派的最終協議以設立北愛議會的方式維持了分治，而共和軍的北部戰線在停火後繼續運作，直到更長的衝突取代了它。
impactEn: The consequences of this war reached well beyond the two countries involved. First, it pushed the Irish question from home rule to sovereignty: the autonomist settlement was rendered impossible by the war itself, and in 1921 Sinn Féin split into a parliamentary wing that accepted the Anglo-Irish Treaty and built the Irish Free State in December 1922, and a military wing that refused and split again in 1923 into an official wing refusing to enter parliament and a provisional wing committed to the fight; that fissure has run through Irish politics ever since. Second, it shook British domestic politics: the Irish campaign, the Curragh mutiny and the truce talks brought down a government that had been in Conservative hands, and the Labour Party took office for the first time in 1923, with open parliamentary argument pushing the question of devolution for England and Scotland back onto the agenda. Third, it wrote a textbook that later armed struggles copied: flying columns, an intelligence chain, rural safe houses and a decentralised command structure, together with overseas sources of arms and urban guerrilla work, all of it reappears almost unchanged in the situation in the north four decades later. Fourth, in international terms the Irish case was referred to the League of Nations in 1921, and Britain, though it refused in the end to accept the Labour government's wider claims, made the truce itself under the pressure of outside comment. Fifth, the war froze the northern question: the unionist and nationalist arrangement ended in the creation of a parliament in Northern Ireland that preserved the partition, and the IRA's northern campaign continued after the truce until a far longer conflict took its place.
result: 點算的結果分三層。軍事上，共和軍沒有以武力取得全島，英方也無法以武力消滅它：1921年12月6日《英愛條約》簽訂，12月11日中午1時停火生效，愛爾蘭島內的公開戰鬥停了下來。政治上，共和國被放棄，愛爾蘭自治邦於1922年12月6日成立，成立時的版圖是全島三十二郡中的二十六郡；北愛的六郡留給英國，並設了北愛議會。組織上，共和軍在停火時保留了完整的郡旅與省區指揮架構，這份架構在兩個月後的內戰中被兩邊同時使用，說明戰爭並沒有消滅任何一方，只是改變了爭鬥的說法。長期看，1922年6月28日開打、1923年5月以共和軍失敗告終的愛爾蘭內戰，把自治邦與反對派的分裂固定下來；1926年成立的芬納愛爾黨在1932年取得選舉勝利，這條由戰爭開啟的政治路線最終在1949年以共和國宣告結束；而共和軍分裂出的正統派與臨時派，其中臨時派在1969年以後進入北愛，成為此後數十年北愛衝突的組織源頭。
resultEn: The result can be counted on three levels. Militarily the IRA did not take the island by force of arms, and Britain could not destroy it by force of arms either: the Anglo-Irish Treaty was signed on 6 December 1921, the truce took effect at 1 p.m. on 11 December, and open fighting on the island stopped. Politically the republic was given up, and the Irish Free State came into being on 6 December 1922 with the twenty-six of the island's thirty-two counties; the six counties of the north stayed with Britain, and were given a parliament of their own. Organisationally the IRA kept its entire network of county brigades and provincial commands at the moment of the truce, and that structure was used by both sides within two months in the civil war, which shows that the war destroyed neither party but changed the terms on which they fought. In the longer run the Irish Civil War, which opened on 28 June 1922 and ended in defeat for the IRA in May 1923, fixed the split between Free State and opposition; Fianna Fáil, founded in 1926, won the election of 1932, and the political line opened by the war finally ended with the proclamation of the republic in 1949. And of the two IRA factions, the official and the provisional, it was the provisional that moved into the north after 1969 and became the organisational source of the decades of conflict in Northern Ireland.
